sourceContext.originPage: NZMP category-landing page (Global Ingredients Network) - intro banner

contentPattern.structure: text cell (H1 + short green underline accent + one-line tagline) | large landscape companion image cell

suitableFor: category / landing page intro banners (H1 + short tagline beside one large companion photo)
top-of-page two-column intros on a light banner tint, image-dominant on the right
mid-level section landing headers across the category-landing template
notSuitableFor: product summary heroes with an intro paragraph, features list, tag pills and a primary CTA (use columns-product)
full-bleed background-image hero banners (use hero / carousel-banner)

usage.reuseNote: application-concept-detail (high-protein-brownie-mix): Reused for the product concept banner (H1 + green accent + one-line tagline beside a single large companion photo; no CTA/list/pills). | ingredient-category (dairy-fats-cream/blends): Reused for the 'Blends' category banner (H1 + green accent underline + one-line tagline beside a large companion photo on the ghost-white .categoryBanner band; no CTA).
